docs.summary: Centralized save system for the editor. Handles Ctrl+S, auto-save, and compiles results from all save handlers into a single toast notification. Subsystems register via [`OnSave`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Projects.SaveManager~OnSave) and return what they saved. The manager fires all handlers, collects labels, and shows one combined toast.
Event fired when a project save is requested (Ctrl+S or auto-save). Each subscriber should save its dirty state and return a label, or null if clean.
Auto-save interval in seconds. Set to 0 to disable. Default 300 (5 minutes).
Whether auto-save is enabled, from the editor preferences.

True while [`OnSave`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Projects.SaveManager~OnSave) handlers are running as part of an auto-save rather than a manual Ctrl+S. Handlers should check this before showing user-facing prompts (e.g. a Save As dialog for a never-saved scene) - auto-save must never interrupt the user unattended.
Fired to list what has unsaved changes. Each subscriber adds one label per unsaved item, worded like its save toast label.
Call once per frame from the editor's update loop. Checks for Ctrl+S shortcut and auto-save timer.

docs.summary: Trigger a save. Fires all [`OnSave`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Projects.SaveManager~OnSave) handlers and shows a combined toast. Can be called manually from menu items or other systems.
For a save handler about to open a Save As dialog: what to run once the file is written, so an unsaved changes prompt can carry on.
Everything with unsaved changes, as labels.
Runs `proceed` when nothing is unsaved, otherwise asks to save everything, discard it, or cancel first.
